data configured as DiagnosticDataIdentifier which is referenced by a
DiagnosticServiceDataIdentifierPortMapping of category GENERIC_ UDS_SERVICE,
then
the
Diagnostic Server instance
shall
use
the
in-
stance
of
the
diag::GenericUDSService
class
([SWS_DM_00602])
refer-
enced by the DiagnosticServiceDataIdentifierPortMapping and call its
